description:
Fantastic family home set on large corner style plot in a highly sought after cul-de-sac location. With en-suite, double driveway and good sized garden, this home is tastefully decorated and offers spacious accommodation throughout. The property also has easy access to local schools, shops, the A1(M) and A66(M) for commuting. The accommodation is laid out across three floors and is accessed via a composite type front door which opens into the reception hallway. From the hallway, there is access to a separate living room and kitchen/dining room. The living room is to the front and the kitchen/dining room is a spacious area opening onto the rear garden. To the first floor there is a landing area, two double bedrooms and the main bathroom. There is a study area to the front which has staircase to the second floor. The second floor is occupied by a master suite style bedroom which benefits from Velux windows and en-suite shower room. The en-suite is partially tiled with a shower cubicle. The property is situated at the end of a cul-de-sac on a great sized corner style plot. There is a double width driveway to the side and garden area with pathway to the front. To the rear is a good sized enclosed garden which is mainly laid to lawn with patio area and side gate.

RECEPTION HALLWAY Entered via composite style door with staircase to first floor.

LIVING ROOM Separate reception room with bay window to front.

KITCHEN/DINING ROOM Open plan area with fitted units, integrated oven/hob with extractor above, worktops, tiled splashback areas, sink unit and French doors and window to the rear. There is also ample space for dining furniture.

FIRST FOOR LANDING Access to upstairs accommodation.

BEDROOM TWO With window to front.

BEDROOM THREE With window to rear.

BATHROOM Partially tiled and fitted with suite comprising bath, toilet and sink.

STUDY AREA With window to front and staircase to second floor.

SECOND FLOOR

BEDROOM ONE Master bedroom style suite with Velux windows and en-suite.

EN-SUITE Partially tiled with shower cubicle, toilet and sink.

EXTERNALLY Outside to the front the property is situated at the end of a cul-de-sac on a great sized corner style plot. There is a double width driveway to the side and garden area with pathway to the front. To the rear is a good sized enclosed garden which is mainly laid to lawn with patio area and side gate.

GENERAL INFORMATION

Council Tax - Band C Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
